name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect — Student Networking & Peer Skill Exchange Platform (C++17 Terminal App)

scripts.build: if which g++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -g -I include src/main.cpp src/user.cpp src/student.cpp src/connection_request.cpp src/match_engine.cpp src/file_manager.cpp src/campus_connect_app.cpp -o CampusConnect; else echo "Using precompiled CampusConnect binary"; fi

author: CampusConnect Team
